about: NOTE-4 extent cases for the parts reader (cad/part_words): for each sentence, the model as the reader sees it (its parts and the areas it offers) and the extent the phrase must get - 'whole' (whole parts, or a listed area) or 'portion' (a piece of one part no row is, told as the nearest there is). The name a user gives a part, in any word or language, is the whole part; geometry decides first where the words resolve to an area (cad/part_features whole_part). m483 round 12, 6c: 'the base plate' of a one-plate NEMA17 mount was read as a piece of it.

sentences.model: one flat motor-mount plate with 4 holes (one plate: no flat face offered)
sentences.sentence: 2 mm elements on the base plate
sentences.reason: the plate is the whole part (6c)

sentences.model: one L-shaped flat plate (one flat face, no bend)
sentences.sentence: 1.5 mm elements on the vertical leg
sentences.reason: a piece of the one face (6b)

sentences.sentence: use 3 mm elements for the mount
sentences.reason: the part's role is its name

sentences.sentence: finer on the upper half of the housing

expect.extent_words: the upper half of the housing

sentences.reason: half of a part is a portion

sentences.model: a flat plate bolted to a square-tube frame (two bodies)
sentences.reason: the plate is one body, all of it

sentences.sentence: 1 mm at the left end of the rail

expect.extent_words: the left end of the rail

sentences.reason: an end of a part is a portion
the web is a piece of the beam when no area is offered for it
another language: the part's name is still the whole part

sentences.sentence: finer near the tip of the blade

expect.extent_words: near the tip of the blade

sentences.reason: near the tip is a portion

sentences.model: bolted joint: two plates and 4 bolts
